info.name: Pathfinder Functional Backend API
info.description:
Pathfinder Functional Backend API Collection
Updated: September 2, 2026

Authentication:
All endpoints except /api/auth/* and /api/health
require a JWT. The Pre-request Script auto-injects
Authorization: Bearer {{jwt_token}} on every request.

Execution order: POST → GET → PUT → DELETE
Run in sequence — all IDs auto-saved between requests.
No manual copying of IDs needed.

Collection Variables (auto-managed):
  jwt_token        → JWT from login/register
  userId           → user.id from auth
  mapId            → id from POST /api/maps
  obstacleId       → id from POST /api/obstacles
  startWaypointId  → id from first waypoint (name contains 'start')
  endWaypointId    → id from second waypoint (name contains 'end')
  waypointId       → generic waypoint id
  routeId          → id from POST /api/routes

Stats endpoints are now at /api/stats/* (moved from /stats/*).
